question: A man goes to Nagpur from Visakhapatnam at a speed of 55 km/hr and returns to Visakhapatnam at speed of 66 km/hr, through the same route. What is his average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the same distance is covered at speeds S₁ and S₂, the average speed formula is:

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

⇒ Average Speed = (2 × 55 × 66) ÷ (55 + 66)

⇒ Average Speed = (7260) ÷ 121

⇒ Average Speed = 60 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Speed of onward journey (S₁) = 55 km/hr

⇒ Speed of return journey (S₂) = 66 km/hr

⇒ Let the uniform distance between Visakhapatnam and Nagpur be D km.

 
 
 Visakhapatnam
 Nagpur
 
• 
 Distance = D
 
• 
 

 Speed = 55 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = D + D = 2D km

⇒ Time taken for onward journey = D ÷ 55 hours

⇒ Time taken for return journey = D ÷ 66 hours

⇒ Total Time = (D ÷ 55) + (D ÷ 66)

⇒ Total Time = (6D + 5D) ÷ 330 = 11D ÷ 330 = D ÷ 30 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 2D ÷ (D ÷ 30)

⇒ Average Speed = 2 × 30 = 60 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 60 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for 3 Equal Distances

If three equal distances are covered at speeds x, y, and z respectively, then Average Speed = (3 × x × y × z) ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Conversion of Units

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by (5 ÷ 18). Conversely, to convert m/s to km/hr, multiply the value by (18 ÷ 5).

Relative Speed

If two objects move in the same direction at speeds S₁ and S₂ (where S₁ > S₂), their Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. If they move in opposite directions, their Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.
